# ACR OpsRoom

> The Cryptographic, Byzantine-Fault-Tolerant War Room for Autonomous Enterprise AI. Beyond Salesforce Agentforce & Slack.

- **Architecture:** Goal-Directed DAG Planning (Atlas 2.0) with M-of-N Quorum Consensus
- **Safety:** 67% Byzantine Fault Tolerance, Ed25519 W3C DIDs, ToolHive Zero-Trust Sandboxing
- **Surface:** Live Collaborative Dynamic Ops Canvas & Synthetic Multi-Agent Huddle Fabric
- **License:** Apache-2.0
- **Repo Index:** 21st canonical ecosystem repo in Agentic Chat Rooms (ACR)
